original: atha ha paiṅgalo yājñavalkyamupasametya dvādaśavarśaśuśrūṣāpūrvakaṃ paramarahasyakaivalyamanubrūhīti papraccha | sa hovāca yājñnavalkyaḥ sadeva somyedamagra āsīt | tannityamuktamavikriyaṃ satyajñānānandaṃ paripūrṇaṃ sanātanamekamevādvitīyaṃ brahma |
analyzed: atha ha paiṅgalaḥ yājñavalkyam upasametya dvādaśa varśa śuśrūṣā pūrvakam parama rahasya kaivalyam anubrūhi iti papraccha sa ha uvāca yājñnavalkyaḥ sat eva somya idam agre āsīt tat nityam uktam avikriyam satya jñāna ānandam paripūrṇam sanātanam ekam eva advitīyam brahma

original: tasminmaruśuktikāsthāṇusphaṭikādau jalaraupyapuruṣarekhādivallohitaśuklakṛṣṇaguṇamayī guṇasāmyānirvācyā mūlaprakṛtirāsīt | tatpratibimbitaṃ yattatsākṣicaitanyamāsīt | sā punarvikṛtiṃ prāpya sattvodriktā'vyaktākhyāvaraṇaśaktirāsīt | tatpratibimbitaṃ yattadīśvaracaitanyamāsīt |
analyzed: tasmin maru śuktikā sthāṇu sphaṭika ādau jala raupya puruṣa rekhā ādi vat lohita śukla kṛṣṇa guṇa mayī guṇa sāmya anirvācyā mūlaprakṛtiḥ āsīt tat pratibimbitam yat tat sākṣi caitanyam āsīt sā punar vikṛtim prāpya sattva udrikta avyakta ākhya āvaraṇa śaktiḥ āsīt tat pratibimbitam yat tat īśvara caitanyam āsīt

original: sa svādhīnamāyaḥ sarvajñaḥ sṛṣṭisthitilayānāmādikartā jagadaṅkurarūpo bhavati | svasminvilīnaṃ sakalaṃ jagadāvirbhāvayati | prāṇikarmavaśādeṣa paṭo yadvatprasāritaḥ prāṇikarmakṣayātpunastirobhāvayati | tasminnevākhilaṃ viśvaṃ saṅkocitapaṭavadvartate | īśādhiṣṭhitāvaraṇaśaktito rajodriktā mahadākhyā vikṣepaśaktirāsīt |
analyzed: sa svādhīna māyaḥ sarvajñaḥ sṛṣṭi sthiti layānām ādikartā jagat aṅkura rūpaḥ bhavati svasmin vilīnam sakalam jagat āvirbhāvayati prāṇi karma vaśāt eṣa paṭaḥ yadvat prasāritaḥ prāṇi karma kṣayāt punar tirobhāvayati tasmin eva akhilam viśvam saṅkocita paṭa vat vartate īśa dhiṣṭhita āvaraṇa śaktitaḥ rajā udriktā mahat ākhyā vikṣepa śaktiḥ āsīt

original: tatpratibimbitaṃ yattaddhiraṇyagarbhacaitanyamāsīt | sa mahattattvābhimānī spaṣṭāspaṣṭavapurbhavati | hiraṇyagarbhādhiṣṭhitavikṣepaśaktitastamodriktāhaṅkārābhidhā sthūlaśaktirāsīt | tatpratibimbitaṃ yattadvirāṭacaitanyamāsīt | sa tadabhimānī spaṣṭavapuḥ sarvasthūlapālako viṣṇuḥ pradhānapuruṣo bhavati | tasmādātmana ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ | ākāśādvāyuḥ |
analyzed: tat pratibimbitam yat tat hiraṇyagarbha caitanyam āsīt sa mahat tattva abhimānī spaṣṭa aspaṣṭa vapūḥ bhavati hiraṇyagarbha dhiṣṭhita vikṣepa śaktitaḥ tama udrikta ahaṅkāra abhidhā sthūla śaktiḥ āsīt tat pratibimbitam yat tat virāṭa caitanyam āsīt sa tad abhimānī spaṣṭa vapūḥ sarva sthūla pālakaḥ viṣṇuḥ pradhāna puruṣaḥ bhavati tasmāt ātmanaḥ ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ ākāśāt vāyuḥ

original: vāyoragniḥ | agnerāpaḥ | adbhyaḥ pṛthivī | tāni pañca tanmātrāṇi triguṇāni bhavanti | sraṣṭukāmo jagadyonistamoguṇamadhiṣṭhāya sūkṣmatanmātrāṇi bhūtāni sthūlīkartuṃ so'kāmayata |
analyzed: vāyoḥ agniḥ agneḥ āpaḥ adbhyaḥ pṛthivī tāni pañca tanmātrāṇi triguṇāni bhavanti sraṣṭu kāmaḥ jagadyoniḥ tamaḥ guṇam adhiṣṭhāya sūkṣma tanmātrāṇi bhūtāni sthūlīkartum saḥ ukāmayata

original: sṛṣṭeḥ parimitāni bhūtānyekamekaṃ dvidhā vidhāya punaścaturdhā kṛtvā svasvetaradvitīyāṃśaiḥ pañcadhā saṃyojya pañcīkṛtabhūtairanantakoṭibrahmāṇḍāni tattadaṇḍocitagolakasthūlaśarīrāṇyasṛjat | sa pañcabhūtānāṃ rajoṃśāṃścaturdhā kṛtvā bhāgatrayātpañcavṛttyātmakaṃ prāṇamasṛjat | sa teṣāṃ turyabhāgena karmendriyāṇyasṛjat |
analyzed: sṛṣṭeḥ parimitāni bhūtāni ekam ekam dvidhā vidhāya punar caturdhā kṛtvā sva sva itara dvitīya aṃśaiḥ pañcadhā saṃyojya pañcīkṛta bhūtaiḥ ananta koṭi brahmāṇḍāni tad tad aṇḍa ucita golaka sthūlaśarīrāṇi asṛjat sa pañcabhūtānām raja uṃśān caturdhā kṛtvā bhāga trayāt pañca vṛtti ātmakam prāṇam asṛjat sa teṣām turya bhāgena karmendriyāṇi asṛjat

original: sa teṣāṃ sattvāṃśaṃ caturdhā kṛtvā bhāgatrayasamaṣṭitaḥ pañcakriyāvṛttyātmakamantaḥkaraṇamasṛjat | sa teṣāṃ sattvaturīyabhāgena jñānendriyāṇyasṛjat | sattvasamaṣṭita indriyapālakānasṛjat | tāni sṛṣṭānyaṇḍe prācikṣipat | tadājñayā samaṣṭyaṇḍaṃ vyāpya tānyatiṣṭhan | tadājñayāhaṅkārasamanvito virāṭ sthūlānyarakṣat |
analyzed: sa teṣām sattva aṃśam caturdhā kṛtvā bhāga traya samaṣṭitaḥ pañcakriyā vṛtti ātmakam antaḥkaraṇam asṛjat sa teṣām sattva turīya bhāgena jñāna indriyāṇi asṛjat sattva samaṣṭitaḥ indriya pālakān asṛjat tāni sṛṣṭāni aṇḍe prācikṣipat tad ājñayā samaṣṭi aṇḍam vyāpya tāni atiṣṭhan tad ājñayā ahaṅkāra samanvitaḥ virāj sthūlāni arakṣat

original: hiraṇyagarbhastadājñayā sūkṣmāṇyapālayat | aṇḍasthāni tāni tena vinā spandituṃ ceṣṭituṃ vā na śekuḥ | tāni cetanīkartuṃ so'kāmayata brahmāṇḍabrahmarandhrāṇi samastavyaṣṭimastakānvidārya tadevānuprāviśat | tadā jaḍānyapi tāni cetanavatsvakarmāṇi cakrire | sarvajñeśo māyāleśasamanvito vyaṣṭidehaṃ praviśya tayā mohito jīvatvamagamat |
analyzed: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ tad ājñayā sūkṣmāṇi apālayat aṇḍa sthāni tāni tena vinā spanditum ceṣṭitum vā na śekuḥ tāni cetanīkartum saḥ ukāmayata brahmāṇḍa brahmarandhrāṇi samasta vyaṣṭi mastakān vidārya tat eva anuprāviśat tadā jaḍāni api tāni cetana vat sva karmāṇi cakrire sarvajña īśaḥ māyā leśa samanvitaḥ vyaṣṭi deham praviśya tayā mohitaḥ jīva tvam agamat

original: śarīratrayatādātmyātkartṛtvabhoktṛtvatāmagamat | jāgratsvapnasuṣuptimūrcchāmaraṇadharmayukto ghaṭīyantravadudvigno jāto mṛta iva kulālacakranyāyena paribhramatīti || iti prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1||
analyzed: śarīra traya tādātmyāt kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva tām agamat jāgrat svapna suṣupti mūrcchā maraṇa dharma yuktaḥ ghaṭīyantra vat udvignaḥ jātaḥ mṛtaḥ iva kulāla cakra nyāyena paribhramati iti iti prathamaḥ adhyāyaḥ 1

original: atha paiṅgalo yājñavalkyamuvāca sarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisthityantakṛdvibhūrīśaḥ kathaṃ jīvatvamagamaditi | sa hovāca yājñavalkyaḥ sthūlasūkṣmakāraṇadehodbhavapūrvakaṃ jīveśvarasvarūpaṃ vivicya kathayāmīti sāvadhānenaikāgratayā śrūyatām | īśaḥ pañcīkṛtamahābhūtaleśānādāya vyaṣṭisamaṣṭyātmakasthūlaśarīrāṇi yathākramamakarot |
analyzed: atha paiṅgalaḥ yājñavalkyam uvāca sarva lokānām sṛṣṭi sthiti anta kṛt vibhūḥ īśaḥ katham jīva tvam agamat iti sa ha uvāca yājñavalkyaḥ sthūla sūkṣma kāraṇa deha udbhava pūrvakam jīveśvara svarūpam vivicya kathayāmi iti sāvadhānena ekāgra tayā śrūyatām īśaḥ pañcīkṛta mahābhūta leśān ādāya vyaṣṭi samaṣṭi ātmaka sthūlaśarīrāṇi yathākramam akarot

original: kapālacarmāntrāsthimāṃsanakhāni pṛthivyaṃśāḥ | raktamūtralālāsvedādikamavaṃśāḥ | kṣuttṛṣṇoṣṇamohamaithunādyā agnyaṃśāḥ | pracāraṇottāraṇaśvāsādikā vāyvaṃśāḥ | kāmakrodhādayo vyomāṃśāḥ | etatsaṅghātaṃ karmaṇi sañcitaṃ tvagādiyuktaṃ bālyādyavasthābhimānāspadaṃ bahudopāśrayaṃ sthūlaśarīraṃ bhavati ||
analyzed: kapāla carma antra asthi māṃsa nakhāni pṛthivī aṃśāḥ rakta mūtra lālā sveda ādi kam avaṃśāḥ kṣudh tṛṣṇā uṣṇa moha maithuna ādyāḥ agni aṃśāḥ pracāraṇa uttāraṇa śvāsa ādikāḥ vāyu aṃśāḥ kāma krodha ādayaḥ vyoma aṃśāḥ etat saṅghātam karmaṇi sañcitam tvac ādi yuktam bālya ādi avasthā abhimāna āspadam bahu dopa āśrayam sthūlaśarīram bhavati

original: athāpañcīkṛtamahābhūtarajoṃśabhāgatrayasamaṣṭitaḥ prāṇamasṛjat | prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānāḥ prāṇavṛttayaḥ | nāgakūrmakṛkaradevadattadhanañjayā upaprāṇāḥ | hṛdāsananābhikaṇṭhasarvāṅgāni sthānāni | ākāśādirajoguṇaturīyabhāgena karmendriyamasṛjat | vākpāṇipādapāyūpāsthāstadvṛttayaḥ | vacanādānagamanavisargānandāstadviṣayāḥ ||
analyzed: atha a pañcīkṛta mahābhūta rajaḥ ṛṃśa bhāga traya samaṣṭitaḥ prāṇam asṛjat prāṇa apāna vyāna udāna samānāḥ prāṇa vṛttayaḥ nāga kūrma kṛkara devadatta dhanañjayāḥ upaprāṇāḥ hṛd āsana nābhi kaṇṭha sarva aṅgāni sthānāni ākāśa ādi rajaḥ guṇa turīya bhāgena karmendriyam asṛjat vāc pāṇi pāda pāyu upāsthāḥ tad vṛttayaḥ vacana ādāna gamana visarga ānandāḥ tad viṣayāḥ

original: evaṃ bhūtasattvāṃśabhāgatrayasamaṣṭito'ntaḥkaraṇamasṛjat | antaḥkaraṇamanobuddhicittāhaṅkārāstadvṛttayaḥ | saṅkalpaniścayasmaraṇābhimānānusandhānāstadviṣayāḥ | galavadananābhihṛdayabhrūmadhyaṃ sthānam | bhūtasatvaturīyabhāgena jñānendriyamasṛjat | śrotratvakcakṣurjivhāghrāṇāstadvṛttayaḥ | śabdasparśarūparasagandhāstadviṣayāḥ |
analyzed: evam bhūta sattva aṃśa bhāga traya samaṣṭitaḥ ntaḥkaraṇam asṛjat antaḥkaraṇa manaḥ buddhi citta ahaṅkārāḥ tad vṛttayaḥ saṅkalpa niścaya smaraṇa abhimāna anusandhānāḥ tad viṣayāḥ gala vat ana nābhi hṛdaya bhrū madhyam sthānam bhūta satva turīya bhāgena jñāna indriyam asṛjat śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jivhā ghrāṇāḥ tad vṛttayaḥ śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandhāḥ tad viṣayāḥ

original: digvātārkapraceto'śvivahnīndropendramṛtyukāḥ | candro viṣṇuścaturvaktraḥ śambhuśca kāraṇādhipāḥ || athānnamayaprāṇamayamanomayavijñāmayānandamayāḥ pañca kośāḥ | annarasenaiva bhūtvānnarasenābhivṛddhiṃ prāpyānnarasamayapṛthivyāṃ yadvilīyate so'nnamayakośaḥ | tadeva sthūlaśarīram | karmendriyaiḥ saha prāṇādipañcakaṃ prāṇamayakośaḥ |
analyzed: diś vāta arka praceta uśvi vahni indra upendra mṛtyukāḥ candraḥ viṣṇuḥ caturvaktraḥ śambhuḥ ca kāraṇa adhipāḥ atha anna maya prāṇa maya manaḥ maya vijñā maya ānanda mayāḥ pañca kośāḥ anna rasena eva bhūtvā anna rasena abhivṛddhim prāpya anna rasa maya pṛthivyām yat vilīyate sa unna maya kośaḥ tat eva sthūlaśarīram karmendriyaiḥ saha prāṇa ādi pañcakam prāṇa maya kośaḥ

original: jñānendriyaiḥ saha buddhirvijñānamayakośaḥ | etatkośatrayaṃ liṅgaśarīram | svarūpājñānamānandamayakośaḥ | tatkāraṇaśarīram || atha jñānendriyapañcakaṃ karmendriyapañcakaṃ prāṇādipañcakaṃ viyadādipañcakamantaḥkaraṇacatuṣṭayaṃ kāmakarmatamāṃsyaṣṭapuram || iśājñayā virājo vyaṣṭidehaṃ praviśya buddhimadhiṣṭhāya viśvatvamagamat |
analyzed: jñāna indriyaiḥ saha buddhiḥ vijñāna maya kośaḥ etat kośa trayam liṅga śarīram svarūpa ajñānam ānanda maya kośaḥ tat kāraṇa śarīram atha jñāna indriya pañcakam karmendriya pañcakam prāṇa ādi pañcakam viyat ādi pañcakam antaḥkaraṇa catuṣṭayam kāma karma tamāṃsi aṣṭa puram iś ājñayā virājaḥ vyaṣṭi deham praviśya buddhim adhiṣṭhāya viśva tvam agamat

original: vijñānātmā cidābhāso viśvo vyāvahāriko jāgratsthūladehābhimānī karmabhūriti ca viśvasya nāma bhavati | īśājñayā sūtrātmā vyaṣṭisūkṣmaśarīraṃ praviśya mana adhiṣṭhāya taijasatvamagamat | taijasaḥ prātibhāsikaḥ svapnakalpita iti taijasasya nāma bhavati | īśājñayā māyopādhiravyaktasamanvito vyaṣṭikāraṇaśarīraṃ praviśya prājñatvamagamat |
analyzed: vijñānātmā cit ābhāsaḥ viśvaḥ vyāvahārikaḥ jāgrat sthūla deha abhimānī karma bhūḥ iti ca viśvasya nāma bhavati īśa ājñayā sūtra ātmā vyaṣṭi sūkṣmaśarīram praviśya manaḥ adhiṣṭhāya taijasa tvam agamat taijasaḥ prātibhāsikaḥ svapna kalpitaḥ iti taijasasya nāma bhavati īśa ājñayā māyā upādhiḥ avyakta samanvitaḥ vyaṣṭi kāraṇa śarīram praviśya prājña tvam agamat

original: prājñovicchinnaḥ pāramārthikaḥ suṣuptyabhimānīti prājñasya nāma bhavati | avyaktaleśājñānācchāditapāramārthikajīvasya tattvamasyādivākyāni brahmaṇaikatāṃ jaguḥ netarayorvyāvahārikaprātibhāsikayoḥ | antaḥkaraṇapratibimbitacaitanyaṃ yattadevāvasthātrayabhāgbhavati |
analyzed: prājñaḥ vicchinnaḥ pāramārthikaḥ suṣupti abhimānī iti prājñasya nāma bhavati avyakta leśa ajñāna ācchādita pāramārthika jīvasya tattvamasyādi vākyāni brahmaṇā ekatām jaguḥ na itarayoḥ vyāvahārika prātibhāsikayoḥ antaḥkaraṇa pratibimbita caitanyam yat tat eva avasthā traya bhāj bhavati

original: sa jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāḥ prāpya ghaṭīyantravadudvigno jāto mṛta iva sthito bhavati | atha jāgratsvapnasuṣuptimūrcchāmaraṇādyavasthāḥ pañca bhavanti || tattaddevatāgrahānvitaiḥ śrotrādijñānendriyaiḥ śabdyādyarthaviṣayagrahaṇajñānaṃ jāgradavasthā bhavati | tatra bhrūmadhyaṃ gato jīva āpādamastakaṃ vyāpya kṛṣiśravaṇādyakhilakriyākartā bhavati |
analyzed: sa jāgrat svapna suṣupti avasthāḥ prāpya ghaṭīyantra vat udvignaḥ jātaḥ mṛtaḥ iva sthitaḥ bhavati atha jāgrat svapna suṣupti mūrcchā maraṇa ādi avasthāḥ pañca bhavanti tad tad devatā graha anvitaiḥ śrotra ādi jñāna indriyaiḥ śabdi ādi artha viṣaya grahaṇa jñānam jāgrat avasthā bhavati tatra bhrūmadhyam gataḥ jīvaḥ āpādamastakam vyāpya kṛṣi śravaṇa ādi akhila kriyā kartā bhavati

original: tattatphalabhuk ca bhavati | lokāntaragataḥ karmārjitaphalaṃ sa eva bhuṅkte | sa sārvabhaumavadvyavahārācchrānta antarbhavanaṃ praveṣṭuṃ mārgamāśritya tiṣṭhati | karaṇoparame jāgratsaṃskārotthaprabodhavadgrāhyagrāhakarūpasphuraṇaṃ svapnāvasthā bhavati |
analyzed: tad tad phala bhuj ca bhavati loka antara gataḥ karma arjita phalam saḥ eva bhuṅkte sa sārvabhauma vat vyavahārāt śrāntaḥ antar bhavanam praveṣṭum mārgam āśritya tiṣṭhati karaṇa uparame jāgrat saṃskāra uttha prabodha vat grāhya grāhaka rūpa sphuraṇam svapna avasthā bhavati

original: tatra viśva eva jāgradvyavahāralopānnāḍīmadhyaṃ caraṃstaijasatvamavāpya vāsanārūpakaṃ jagadvaicitryaṃ svabhāsā bhāsayanyathepsitaṃ svayaṃ bhuṅkte || cittaikakaraṇā suṣuptyavasthā bhavati | bhramaviśrāntaśakuniḥ pakṣau saṃhṛtya nīḍābhimukhaṃ yathā gacchati tathā jīvo'pi jāgratsvapnaprapañce vyavahṛtya śrānto'jñānaṃ praviśya svānandaṃ bhuṅkte ||
